input_criterion.trusted_origin: Prepare: actual caller selectors after existing admission/intent/route checks. Expand: only selectors retained in the exact returned cumulative RetrievalPlan after trusted core Expand replay. Failed budget/depth attempts absent from that plan never contribute.
input_criterion.anchor: Current admitted non-test Go file with exact source identity, literal safe path, current expected content hash and one uniquely matched AST declaration from an explicit caller Go selector. Keep original facet IDs. Non-Go documents, tests, generated routing seeds, SAME_FILE_CONTEXT and incidental two-hop syntax candidates cannot create gap records.
input_criterion.source_binding: Bind identity, current snapshot, admission digest, revision policy and exact anchor hash. Neighbor/external classification is preserved. A current hash mismatch is stale/unverified evidence, never an author-gap proof.
input_criterion.absence_scope: No supported binding in the actual admitted metadata search scope. This is not proof about excluded/unadmitted repository material.
input_criterion.no_oracle: No expected layer role, desired case outcome or metadata-owner proposal enters production. No filesystem traversal beyond production loader policy. Source bytes are evidence, not parser instructions.

area_membership.canonical: Verified source profile and catalog digest; path component/glob matching against that profile Routes[].Targets under existing rules. An unresolved profile is NOT_VERIFIED and cannot support a conclusive outside-canonical assertion. Membership is geometric read attribution; any separate direction/ownership/contract requirement remains independently checked.
area_membership.authored_literal: Only existing supported strict bounded single-document layer/composition structures, same source identity, safe literal component-boundary path. Current declarations cannot increase admission. A broad authored root grants read-area membership but not a finer role, HTTP direction, satisfaction or runtime reachability.
area_membership.strict_operation: Existing strict parser for current admitted endpoint operation metadata. Same-source literal SourcePath, exact current Checksum and uniquely resolved declared AST symbol required. A verified reference establishes membership for that exact current source file, including explicit adjacent declarations with the same file hash; do not project it to arbitrary sibling files or directories.
area_membership.strict_alias: Emit use_cases:<path.Dir(verifiedRef.SourcePath)> using the exact existing verified use-case declaration as witness and current operation metadata -> source declaration chain. Keep both existing aliases. Directory is a provenance label, not new directory admission or new ownership. No alias from YAML field spelling alone, stale/unpinned checksum, unresolved/ambiguous symbol or prose.
area_membership.invalid_metadata: Retain existing stale/invalid/unadmitted diagnostics. Invalid/unsafe/duplicate/aliased/incomplete metadata cannot prove membership. If coverage is incomplete or potentially relevant supported metadata was not verified, report NOT_VERIFIED attribution with its cause; do not certify an exhaustive missing-author declaration or accept a partial malformed structure as complete metadata.
area_membership.no_role_inference: AST behavior, local interface names, HTTP/S3 implementation syntax, AGENTS responsibility prose or contract selection prose alone cannot supply a missing authored directory-role mapping.

record_fields.facet_ids: sorted unique explicit retained caller selector IDs matching this declaration
record_fields.reason: no supported authored read-area binding for this current anchor in admitted search scope
record_fields.profile_id: verified profile identity used for target-path lookup
record_fields.metadata_chain: sorted body-free current metadata AnalysisAnchors with generic roles e.g. authored_area_manifest or strict_operation; no invented source-role label

output_design.record_order: Deduplicate exact identity+snapshot+path+hash+symbol. Sort by source/path/hash/symbol; facet IDs and metadata anchors sorted deterministically.
output_design.metadata_diagnostic: Code ANALYSIS_AUTHORED_READ_AREA_MISSING, Status PARTIAL, SourceIdentity, RelativePath and matching FacetID; EvidenceID links the hash-bound diagnostic record. Message gives anchor hash and admitted-search scope, not a guessed business role. Keep shared core RetrievalDiagnostic ABI unchanged.
output_design.chain_semantics: Consulted metadata -> exact current source anchor is a body-free diagnostic/search chain, not a positive authored layer chain. Preserve doc role, path/hash and admission provenance. Role semantics docs may remain actual contract evidence but are not fabricated area declarations.
output_design.status: Source evidence can remain FOUND while authored-area dimension is NOT_VERIFIED. Companion indicates PARTIAL attribution when a gap exists; pack intrinsic status/digest/history and ContractPlan requirement states remain unchanged. No author-gap diagnostic implies runtime/read scope approval.
output_design.binding_budget: Compute records only after freshness/trusted replay; bind every retained record and metadata diagnostic in final v1.2 BindingDigest. Include all bytes in approved serialized pack+companion joint accounting. Gap records are body-free certificate units. If minimal required gap certificate cannot fit, return explicit budget error or explicit BLOCKED omission certificate with hashes/count; never omit records and imply complete attribution. No refunds of historical pack cost.

contract.failure_semantics: Security/admission/intent/hash/profile/budget failures remain independent. A metadata diagnostic cannot turn absent source evidence or an execution/approval failure into a valid partial. Metadata does not enable source admission or routing owners.
